ocr.notes: Gist right but name garbled: the image reads Mrs. Sophie Vellig of the Golden Lion lodging-house.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Jerry Slattery, a prize fighter who hung out around Tom Allen's saloon, was charged after an officer found him beating Mrs. Sophie Vellig at the Golden Lion lodging-house, Seventh and Pine.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic, St. Louis, Mo., Wednesday Morning, December 19, 1894, page 12.

notes: The beating happened at the lodging-house, not outside Allen's saloon; the current title ('arrested for assault outside Tom Allen's saloon') is slightly off but Allen's saloon is only the man's hangout. Suggested title if wanted: 'Prize fighter from Tom Allen's saloon arrested for beating a woman'.
